newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN AVERAGE T-BILL RATE 16.27 PCT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN AVERAGE T-BILL RATE 16.27 PCT.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills fell to 16.27 percent at the latest weekly tender after rising to 16.28 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.860 billion rand. The average price was 95.945 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.54 percent from 15.66 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.320 billion rand. The average price was 92.250 rand percent.
